item.title: What Are Subagents? Explained in 4 Minutes
item.description:
LangChain · score 6 · hits agent, agents, subagent, langchain, harness

Jess Weng, Education Engineer at LangChain, explains subagents in Deep Agents, LangChain's open-source agent harness. A subagent takes one task from the main agent, does the messy work in its own fresh context window, and sends back only the result, so the main agent's context stays focused on the big picture. item.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
item.description:
OpenAI · score 1 · hits codex

Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look. https://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/
